title: Large Language Model in Creative Work: The Role of Collaboration Modality and User Expertise
eligible_reason: Randomized online experiment (ghostwriter vs sounding-board vs control, by expertise); one cross-section of ad copies. Outcomes regressed on condition dummies with lm_robust/glm. No panel or staggered adoption.
design_notes: master_script.Rmd: lm_robust(clicks ~ Condition * expertise ...) and glm count models on data/main_data.csv (one row per participant ad).
data_files_note: README data dictionary; experimental data shipped.
software_notes: R (estimatr lm_robust, glm) plus a Python notebook for text analysis.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read; no DiD/event-study terms. Out of scope.
